summary: Recent discussions in the Iceberg community have focused on various proposals, including the introduction of a generic CatalogObjectIdentifier for the REST catalog spec and enhancements to partition statistics. Additionally, the Iceberg 1.11.0 release is encountering blockers related to licensing and Spark bugs, while ongoing community syncs are addressing recent developments and future goals.
highlights: Discussion on REST Spec: generic CatalogObjectIdentifier
Proposal for populating total_record_count in partition statistics
Proposal to add constraint support in Iceberg
